verdict.rationale: Convex is a database/backend platform (not itself an agent), so an official MCP server is a fair and applicable axis, and it ships one: docs describe 'The Convex Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides several tools that allow AI agents to interact with your Convex deployment,' with a safety default restricting production access. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice and more detail on the full tool list/setup steps.
